title: 60 AI Agents Inside Claude Code (Free GitHub Tool)
description:
Rufflo is sitting at number one on GitHub right now and almost nobody knows about it. It runs 60+ AI agents simultaneously inside Claude Code, cuts your API costs by up to 75%, and extends your Claude Code usage by 250%. Queen agents manage the team, worker agents handle coding, testing, and research. They share memory and get better every run. It's open source and completely free.

Get the Ruflo worfklow here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sIF1q16lpO-TVSe-5JvmPkguC30vVO4y0LsUgtrEvnM/edit?usp=sharing

#ClaudeCode #AIAgents #AITools #OpenSource #AIWorkflow #GitHub #FreeAI
